item.title: Patch now: PostgreSQL: type confusion after ALTER ... SET DATA TYPE executes arbitrary code
item.description:
PostgreSQL: exploited from day 0 (news only) · fix: 18.7, 17.12, 16.16

First step: Update PostgreSQL to the fixed version for your release line (for example 18.7, 17.12 or 16.16).

Type confusion in PostgreSQL allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via ALTER ...

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-6460

item.title: Patch now: UnrealIRCd: Improper Neutralization of Delimiters
item.description:
UnrealIRCd: exploited · fix: 6.2.7.1 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update UnrealIRCd to 6.2.7.1 or later.

UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-114713

item.title: Act now: Check Point (multiple products): Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
item.description:
Check Point (multiple products): exploited from day 0 · check vendor

First step: Follow the vendor advisory for the affected Check Point products: install the update or apply the mitigation it lists.

Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

High · Check vendor · CVE-2026-123039

item.title: Patch (update): Barracuda Networks (multiple products): OS Command Injection
item.description:
Barracuda Networks (multiple products): RCE · internet-facing · exploit chain · exploited · fix: 9.4.0.029, 12.3.1.002, 15.0.0.009

First step: Update the affected Barracuda Networks products to the fixed version for your release line (for example 9.4.0.029, 12.3.1.002 or 15.0.0.009).

Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-111560

item.title: Patch now: Google Chromium: Use-After-Free
item.description:
Google Chromium: Memory corruption (possible RCE) · pre-auth · remote · user interaction · exploited from day 0 · fix: 157.0.8103.50

First step: Update Google Chromium to 157.0.8103.50 or later.

Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-125350

item.title: Patch now: Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG): Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel
item.description:

First step: Update Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) to 9.4.0.030 or later.

Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-116606
